description: Build and start a test run from a suite, a plan, or an explicit list of case IDs, in one step — it resolves the cases itself. It opens a run, it does not close one: for a finished pipeline use qase_ci_report; to assemble a run by hand use qase_run_upsert. Cost: two API calls behind one, about 1s.

environment_id.description: ID of the environment the run executes against

milestone_id.description: ID of the milestone the run belongs to

plan_id.description: Create run from an existing test plan

name: qase_regression_run
title: Build regression run
